description:
Intent i034 (tasklet-napi-softirq-lock, snapshot s05) complete. Three reported findings of locks shared between NET_RX softirq (NAPI poll) context and process context where the process side uses plain spin_lock() with no BH disable:

1. drivers/net/ethernet/freescale/fs_enet/fs_enet-main.c lines 763-778 (medium): fs_enet_close takes plain spin_lock(&fep->tx_lock) at 775 nested in spin_lock_irqsave(&fep->lock) at 774 — IRQs disabled, bottom halves not. The same lock is taken plainly by NAPI poll fs_enet_napi (def 86, netif_napi_add 1033, scheduled from hardirq fs_enet_interrupt: request_irq 742, napi_schedule_prep 344, __napi_schedule 352) at lines 99-188. Zero spin_lock_bh/local_bh_disable anywhere in the file (grep verified), so a poll on the same CPU can spin forever against a preempted close() holder. Confidence medium because napi_disable at 770 and netif_stop_queue at 768 narrow the contending window. Matches sibling facts f029/f031/f033.

2. drivers/net/ethernet/altera/altera_tse_main.c lines 1284-1287 (low): tse_shutdown takes plain spin_lock(&priv->tx_lock) at 1286 (after plain mac_cfg_lock at 1285, no BH disable) against the NAPI side tse_tx_complete plain spin_lock at 452, reached from tse_poll (def 492, netif_napi_add 1565, scheduled from hardirq altera_isr 532-543, request_irq 1207/1216 IRQF_SHARED). The xmit path proves the required discipline: spin_lock_bh(&priv->tx_lock) at 568. Low confidence because napi_disable at 1272, irq disables at 1276-1277, and free_irq at 1281-1282 all precede the plain lock. Matches sibling f030/f031/f033 verdicts.

3. drivers/net/ethernet/sun/cassini.c lines 232-258 (medium): cas_lock_tx takes every cp->tx_lock[i] with plain spin_lock_nested(&cp->tx_lock[i], i) at 237, used by workqueue worker cas_reset_task (def 3993) via cas_lock_all_save at 4020 and by cas_close at 4317 with only spin_lock_irqsave(&cp->lock) — no BH disable. Softirq side: NAPI poll cas_poll (def 2572, netif_napi_add 5095, napi_schedule from handlers at 2446/2497/2548) reaches cas_tx_ringN's plain spin_lock(&cp->tx_lock[ring]) at 1850. Xmit uses the correct spin_lock_irqsave at 2763. Medium confidence: netif_device_detach at 4019 and cas_close's napi_disable at 4309 narrow the window but do not quiesce an already-scheduled poll. Mirrors sibling s06 finding f013.

Also classified: bcm63xx_enet rx_lock and mwl8k tx_lock safe (both-sides-softirq / all process sites _bh); ks7010 seed excluded per rules; iwlwifi pcie/rx.c locks unresolved. Limitations: finalize directive halted whole-tree tasklet/NAPI enumeration (mt76, ath5k, remaining NAPI drivers unexamined); static analysis only — no build/lockdep/runtime reproducer; cassini zero-_bh count not re-verified after a truncated grep; xmit/timer paths excluded by branch definition. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i034.json, snapshots_checked ["s05"], execution_status complete.
